ideas.pitch: A real-time IoT power monitoring and load-balancing prototype built using ESP32 nodes to track and optimize electricity usage across university departments.
ideas.title: Smart Campus IoT Energy Grid
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeted directly at the IoT department hosting the event, demonstrating physical hardware integration and sensor data collection within a short timeframe.

ideas.pitch: An offline computer vision system running on a Raspberry Pi that detects unauthorized entry or safety gear violations in campus computer labs.
ideas.title: Edge-AI Lab Security Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages an unusual physical deployment model and edge AI, which stands out against standard web apps in an open innovation room.

ideas.pitch: An automated sorting prototype utilizing microcontroller-driven color and weight sensors to categorize campus biodegradable versus non-biodegradable waste.
ideas.title: BioTrack Campus Waste Sorter
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly incorporates biotechnology and IoT themes relevant to the organizing departments through a tangible working prototype.

ideas.pitch: A localized peer-to-peer file sharing and version control web utility tailored for university students operating entirely over local Wi-Fi without internet dependency.
ideas.title: PeerSync Decentralized Study Notes
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves a genuine local campus pain point with robust networking code, impressing judges with practical everyday utility.

ideas.pitch: A low-power wireless sensor mesh network using ESP32 nodes to monitor agricultural soil parameters and stream telemetry to a central dashboard.
ideas.title: AgriSensor Soil Moisture Mesh
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines hardware prototyping with agricultural technology, appealing to the IoT focus of the organizing committee.
